popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's Trojan stemma — Tros as eponymous king, father of Ilus, Assaracus and Ganymede, the name that sticks to the land.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus recounts Zeus' gift of immortal horses when Ganymede is taken — Tros compensated for the son who becomes cupbearer.

popCulture.title: Tros (mythology)
popCulture.description: King who gave his name to Troy — father of Ganymede and ancestor of Priam's line.
